name: Stoneskin
description: Level 4 Transmutation (Druid, Navigator, Tidecaller, Shipwright) Casting Time: Action Range: Touch Components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
